author: kycrafft
body: I used to tolerate fisherman in CTH. But I have realized it's completely gamebreaking now. On maps with void, up to half the people playing will choose fisherman. You can't even score points because everyone is more focused about pulling people into the void. There are a few kits that can someone counter it, but honestly 1 hook and you are done, with minimal effort from the fisherman. Please remove it, it's like the poseidon of CTH.
